notes.title: MindSeize is now updated to v.1.5.1.
notes.content:
Hi all!

MindSeize was just patched to version 1.5.1. The patch brings mainly bug fixes and also a couple of new, more interesting features. Here's patch notes.

[list]
[*] Added multiple pieces of failsafe code to some bosses, that could under very rare circumstances soft lock the game. 
[*] There was a high possibility, that Valstrike (of The Duo renown) would deal 10 times the intended damage with his special pulse attack. It's fixed now, oops!
[*] Fixed a case that could apparently cause the T-Snout to not leave after the Hornet Hive is destroyed. We could not replicate the issue, but made some changes that will possibly fix the rare issue!
[*] Fixed the purple mushrooms of Verdant Gamma, that used to cause all kinds of wonky physics if they respawned on top of the player...
[*] Visual fixes, mainly some wrong tiles here and there
[/list]

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Added a hidden way to make the H.A.B.A. boss fight (and some parts of the map) easier, by turning off certain electric traps
[*] Made the price scaling of the Nano Bots less harsh
[*] Added a small but neat destructible section on Verdant Gamma, allowing the player to traverse through the area below the Wrecked Ship faster.
[/list]

Aaaand that would be all, might have missed some smaller bug fixes but anyways... The work continues, even if slower. See you in the future!

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Winter Sale time, working on a patch:)
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jqrCCme.gif[/img]

notes.title: MindSeize updated to v. 1.5.0. Boss improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi! It's once again time to bring you and update to MindSeize. This time we've focused on fixing some issues both big and small, that have plagued the game for a long time. The patch also brings updates to several bosses.

Here's the (mostly) full change list.


Boss balance:

[list]
[*] Drifter Hanu will start his second phase a bit earlier now
[*] Annihilator Unit has a much faster turn animation and starts its final barrage attack earlier than before. Added a new homing missile attack for it. Lowered the HP a bit.
[*] You can now destroy the boomerang grenades of Duke Atlas with a melee attack. They are now faster and do more damage. Duke Atlas should never be locked to a wrong animation when starting his run anymore.
[*] Added an earlier unimplemented special attack for the Phantom Parasite
[*] The Assassin now has a projectile attack, improved the calculation of his dash lengths
[*] Added a tell to the hand shake animation of Mimir. Removed the teleporting shield-carrying Defender from the fight, increased the damage of his flamer drones.
[*] Balanced the difficulty level of the Boss Rush a bit
[/list]

other stuff:

[list]
[*] Changed the geometry and/or enemy placement of several rooms, fixing multiple awkward wall jump spots, etc.
[*] Fixed a bug that could sometimes cause the Muckroot Beast enemies to launch upwards to the sky when fighting on a slope
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Thyr to freeze when fighting him in Boss Rush
[*] Improved the Scrap Magnet
[*] Added more oomph to the destruction of scrap containers and to the scrap collection sfx
[*] Made it impossible to shoot during certain cutscenes
[*] Triggering the elevators of Horizon Ship now works more consistently 
[*] Gave Guardian Units more hp and improved their turn speed
[*] Turrets on Takomo 7 now award scrap for destruction
[*] Tweeked the backend for the controller support. Hopefully this will help with the issues a few of you are still experiencing.
[*]And a couple of other small bugfixes as always
[/list]

Note about the controller tweaks:
We have not been able to replicate the issues described to us and every controller works fine in the tests, which makes finding the root of the issues incredibly difficult for me (as of writing this, I'm the only programmer working on the game anymore). I'm now trying a different method for detecting the inputs, let's see if it will help at all... Once again, if you are having controller issues even after the patch, I would ask you to go to the Steam General Controller Settings and uncheck every "Configuration Support" box. You should also turn on the "Controller Only Movement" from the in-game Options menu. Hoping for these to help!

Also, if some of you start having NEW controller issues that you did not have before this update, please let us know!

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: MindSeize updated to v. 1.4.6. - bugfixes and improvements included!

notes.title: A major update brings some requested features/fixes. MindSeize updated to v1.4.5
notes.content:
MindSeize has been updated to the version 1.4.5.

The patch includes a plethora of improvements, some of which have been requested for quite some time. There's also a number of bugfixes, as always. Full notes below:

Changes and improvements:
[list]
[*]You can now unequip (and re-equip) mods and powerups. 
[*]One additional hidden nanobot container added.
[*]It's now possible to turn on player damage numbers from the Options, helping you keep track of taken damage
[*]Improved the visibility of some smaller enemy projectiles, especially of the first Ascended boss and on the second planet
[*]Improved the Spider Grip, giving the player much more control when clinging on walls
[*]Improvements to the Scrap Magnet speed and reliability
[*]Additional sound effects to menus and the UI
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the lightning sometimes appearing on wrong layer on Takomo 7
[*]Fixed the map showing wrong coordinates when trying to travel after checking a map of another planet
[*]Squeaky Gnawers should not make occasional gigantic jumps anymore...
[*]The screen no longer goes to the cutscene mode when entering some of the boss rooms after having killed the boss
[*]Fixes to the Stranger's dash
[*]Various other bugfixes;)
[/list]

Aaand that's all for now. We are also working on localizations, they could find their way to Steam eventually. Please let us know if you find some bugs or other issues, feedback is also still wanted and appreciated!:)

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: MindSeize updated to version 1.4.0.
notes.content:
MindSeize has been just updated to version 1.4.0.

The main thing we wanted to address with the update is the recent controller problems reported by some of the players. There is now a "Controller Input Only Mode", that can be turned on from the Options menu. We've also tried to improve the controller support on the code side.

If the update or turning on the Controller Only mode will not help with your issues, please try to first unplug and replug the controller, then report to us. These fixes are in many ways experimental, so all the input and feedback from you will help us find solutions.

In addition, the patch improves the late game viability of the first gun, buffs the Scrap Magnet and Arc-Power Beam.

There's of course also a huge list of bugfixes. Here's a (not entirely complete) changelog:

    [list]
[*]Added a "Controller Only Mode" that can be turned on from Options
[*]Changing the keybindings will now correctly change the keys also on the HUD and in UI PopUps (There's currently a small known issue with jump key not updating correctly in the tutorial, will be fixed soon)
[*]Fixed most of the cases that could cause the player to get stuck and not able to move. Probably.
[*]Fixed the sound effect and music volume settings not always getting saved correctly
[*]Fixed Mimir's hands not always disappearing when he dies
[*]Fixed the speed boost from the Desperation Engines staying even after the player health is restored
[*]Fixed ”the invisible grenade-blocking obstacles” sometimes appearing on Takomo 7. Turns out they were dead spider creatures whose invisible dead corpses still blocked grenades for some reason
[*]Fixed the layers in the room before Duke Atlas, screen shake will no longer mess up with the backgrounds
[*]U1-M4 Gear pickup should now be bit smoother.
[*]Re-spawning enemies are no longer invincible when attacked with flamer or the flame dash
[*]Removed a box that could cause issues with the Box Carrying Drones. The drones also now behave better when their boxes are destroyed before they manage to grab them.
[*]Fixed a couple of spots on walls of Icy Moon having small, invisible platforms
[*]Scrap Magnet now picks all the drops from enemies, including health and energy
[*]The Enhanced Ammo Feed mod now boosts the bullet rate of the first weapon much more, making the rate of fire 50% faster than it used to be
[*]Boosted the damage rate of the Arc-Power beam weapon from every 0,5 seconds to every 0,4 seconds. The secondary damage spreads 20% further than it used to.
[/list]



Aaand that's all for now. Thanks for the support and keep reporting the bugs and issues, so we can iron them out one by one.

Cheers!
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: MindSeize has been updated to version 1.3.2.
notes.content:
MindSeize has been updated to version 1.3.2.

The update brings a couple of improvements and some bugfixes.

[list]
[*] Scrap Magnet is now a bit cheaper and a bit more effective
[*] The shield will recharge a bit faster under heavy enemy presence and while taking hits
[*] Added 2 small shortcuts to the Verdant Gamma caves section and small changes to the geometry of some rooms
[*] The Stranger should not freeze anymore. Ever. Hopefully... Ah and fixed a rare bug with Illuminator Drone as well
[*] Using Power Void on a wall will no longer freeze the player under any circumstances. In fact it can't be done!
[*] Increased the contrast of the Thorn Horn root attack (and the monster itself)
[*] Added a check to a certain radio conversation after beating planet Orbei. Won't happen anymore in case the player manages to sequence break;)
[*] Made the Dash Kick Boots tiny bit easier to find...
[*] Fixed one Guardian Unit behaving very, very badly. BAD Guardian Unit!
[*] There was an exploit allowing the player to easily farm scrap. Huge amounts of scrap. INFINITE amounts of scrap. It also froze the game if the amounts got too crazy, so yea... Fixed now!
[*] Improved 2 screen transitions (one on Takomo and one on Research Facility. No you'll be able to jump into new room without problems! 
[/list]

Aaand that's all. There might have been a couple of other fixes as well, but honestly there's too many to remember everything. Thanks for the support!

Cheers!
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: Dash Kick Boots + Shadow Dash hotfix
notes.content:
Hi!

We just updated MindSeize with a small hotfix.

Prior to the patch, if the player had both the Dash Kick Boots and the Shadow Dash, it was possible to get stuck to enemies for a second if trying to dash through them while not having enough energy to perform a shadow dash (10).

That should not happen anymore after the hotfix.

notes.title: A quick platforming update that was omitted from the yesterday's patch
notes.content:
Hey!

Just released a small patch that improves some of the platforming sections on the Research Facility and a bit on Takomo 7.

This one comes very quickly after the last patch, but we figured it would still be worth patching in without waiting for the next bigger update. We've actually had these updated sections ready for a couple of weeks, but as we were watching some of the content you guys have been creating on YouTube and Twitch we noticed, that they were not brought over to the Steam version from the Switch port we are currently finishing. 

This patch simply brings the updated rooms to the Steam version, slightly improving some of the platforming areas and the "outdoors section" of the Research Facility. 

Cheers!

notes.title: A tiny patch with 2 small improvements, internal resource management improved.
notes.content:
Hi!

MindSeize was just updated with a small patch that simplifies and improves the internal memory and resource management that happens when the game is saved, gets paused or when the player moves to a different room. This will mostly not be visible to the player, but in some cases might improve the loading times a bit. It should (hopefully) also fix a rare crash tied to the system.

The patch also adds a "Game Saved!" text when entering your base ship and fixes the Grenadiers on Research Facility sometimes shooting towards wrong direction.

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: MindSeize updated to version 1.2.6. - Fixed bugs from user feedback and reviews.
notes.content:
MindSeize was just updated to version 1.2.6.

Here's what's included in this patch and the one that got released recently:

[list]
[*] Some proofreading for the conversations
[*] Fixed a moonwalking Defender
[*] You can now access the new workshop inventory on the Thyr-mission, without needing to return to ship
[*] Returning to the ship after Thyr-mission now triggers a conversation with Raven automatically
[*] Fixed (once again...) the pyro grenades somehow occasionally working underwater

Lastly, just a small friendly request of a sort: If you've enjoyed MindSeize, we'd be very happy if you wanted to write a Steam review as those really help us and the game. The game has improved greatly since the launch and we'd love for everyone to see that.

And that would be all, thanks!
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: Version 1.2.2 released, balances weapons and healing
notes.content:
Hi there!

MindSeize was just patched, this time we have just a couple of bugfixes and a load of small and bigger balance changes. A couple of bosses also got some tweaking.

Here's notes:
[list]
[*] Boosted the base speed of activating a healing nanobot by 50%
[*] Removed the touch damage from some parts of Mimir, making the fight more balanced
[*] Removed a couple of Assault Hornets from the run sequence at the beginning of Verdant Gamma
[*] Boosted the attack speed of Quad Cutters weapon by 15% and the damage of each combo hit by 1. The attacks during the rage mode of Quad Cutters now restore less energy
[*] Increased the damage of Jet Spear jump attack and air dive attack
[*] Increased the damage of Morph Edge air dive attack
[*] Increased the time between shots of the Plasma Avenger Revolver by 35%, the bullets travel 10% slower
[*] Boosted the damage of the Arc-Power Beam from 4 to 5 and the damage of the secondary hits from 2 to 3. Boosted the damage of the special attack accordingly.
[*] Increased to Rocket Launcher damage from 13 to 15, decreased rocket travel speed by 5%.
[*] Made the map borders a bit easier to read
[*] Fixed a bug with tangle blaster tips and Sentry Drones
[*] Added a map marker for a certain escape pod on Research Facility
[*] Edited the hit boxes of H.A.B.A. boss to fix an exploit
[/list]

And that would be all. Our work continues, thanks for all the support and feedback!

notes.title: New patch released. Changes to Shadow Dash and bugfixes included
notes.content:
Hi!

MindSeize was patched to version 1.2.1. The patch includes some bugfixes, as well as an improvement to the usability of the Shadow Dash.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Shadow Dash ability now automatically triggers when you dash towards enemy and would collide with it. If you have the 10 energy, that is.
[*] Adjusted the Dash Kick Boots to function differently if combined with Shadow Dash.
[*] Fixed the second hit of the melee combo of Morph Edge weapon hurting you if the enemy is not pushed far enough with the first hit (or is stationary).
[*] Randomly pressing mouse buttons in the pause menu no longer causes strange effects to happen

[/list]

And that would be all for now!

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: A quick-fix patch released, fixes Boss Mode weapons and "unusual resolutions"
notes.content:
Hi! Just a quickie.

MindSeize has been patched with a quick-fix patch that fixes the problem with the weapon selection in Boss Mode, when challenging a single boss. You can now choose from all the weapons found in the main game, as intended. 

The patch also makes sure the background graphics don't break when the player tries to run the game in a non-16:9 aspect ratio. (that's done by letterboxing the screen to keep the aspect ratio 16:9).

A small but quite important balance change to some early enemies is thrown in the patch as well, as it didn't quite make it to the last bigger patch in time.

Cheers!

notes.title: Boss Mode Update released - MindSeize goes final!
notes.content:
[b]MindSeize[/b] has just been updated to version 1.2.0, bringing the promised Boss Mode to the game, along with a couple of other improvements. The game now has all the planned features in, no major bugs left and can be considered as ready and final. [b]There will of course still be smaller updates and bug fixes[/b], no worries.

Patch notes:[list]
[*] Added Boss Mode, which allows you to have a rematch against the bosses you beat in the story
[*] The Boss Mode also contains a boss rush mode that unlocks after beating the game
[*] Added achievement for beating the Boss Rush
[*] Added option to change the controller button icons on UI (Xbox, Nintendo, PS, Keyboard)
[*] A couple of balance changes to the prices of mods
[*] You now get to keep all the purchased drone skins, no need to pay every time when you want to change
[*] Shroom Lizard attack speed slightly decreased
[*] Small changes to the geometry of some rooms on the first planet
[*] Getting the U1-M4 Gear changes your MAG color on conversations as well
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/7LmXxp0.png[/img]

MindSeize will be on 25% sale for a week to celebrate.
Big thank you to everyone, we will continue working on MindSeize and keep being active on the community. Until next time!
-Kamina Dimension Crew-

notes.title: New update adds achievements, new content and fixes bugs. Soundtrack available!
notes.content:
We've just updated MindSeize with a patch that brings some new content and fixes a plethora of bugs. Here's a list of new features:


[list]
[*] Added the Steam Achievements to the game. It's possible to unlock most of them retroactively, even if you've played the game already.
[*] Added a planetary log window that allows you to read more about the planets and enemies you encounter. This will be further updated a bit with an upcoming patch.
[*] Added the possibility to change the appearance of your drone companion at the workshop.
[*] Added a new optional boss fight that was originally removed from the game
[*] A couple of changes to the dialogue, there's still a few unreleased chats with your crew that will be added in a future update.
[*] Updates to the map system, these will still continue in the next patch.
[*] Balanced the damage numbers of several weapons and enemy attacks
[*] Bugfixes and a couple of visual fixes.
[/list]


The great soundtrack of MindSeize is now also available on Steam, as well as an artbook that was originally a reward on our Kickstarter campaign.

Thank you for your patience, more updates to come!

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: Patchnotes for the newest set of bugfixes
notes.content:
MindSeize has just been patched with a set of bugfixes. We originally wanted to roll these out with an upcoming quality of life and features update, but decided it's better to just get them online as fast as possible. The second half of the patch will be arriving in the coming days.

Here's the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed several tiles on the map not updating. If you find still more, please write in the community bug thread
[*] It's no longer possible to use invincibility frames to get through the "insta kill spikes"
[*] Updated the map visuals. There will be still fixes and improvements coming to the map.
[*] Dashkick boots no longer destroy the ground below you. Also fixed several bugs with the mod and balanced its power when used together with the calibrated thrusters.
[*] The weapon icon will immediately change when you get a new weapon
[*] Gave tooltips to the collectable energy cells
[*] Balanced the prices of several purchasable mods 
[*] Balanced some boss fights
[*] Loads of small bug fixes 
[/list]

There are still a couple of bigger, no so easy to fix issues we are working on. We try to get them fixed as soon as possible. We have also several new sound effects yet to implement for some enemies. Thank you for patience, that's all for now.

notes.title: MindSeize has been patched. Lots of bugs fixed and several other updates
notes.content:
Hi there!

We have just updated MindSeize, brining it to version 1.01. This patch continues the series of bugfixes we've already made since the release, fixing a couple of important things.

Here's a list, probably missing some fixes that were already patched as hotfixes earlier:


[list]
[*] The game now remembers what weapons you were using in your save
[*] The game now saves also when exiting a save point
[*] You can now shoot diagonally by pressing diagonally when shooting. Currently works only with controller, keyboard support in next patch.
[*] You can now turn off camera shake from the options
[*] Fixed the freezes that sometimes occurred when using the plasma avenger weapon
[*] The elevators will now appear on the map on the second planet
[*] Made the bomber drones on second planet hackable (if you have the correct mod)
[*] Improvements to the fast travel map
[*] Fixed several tooltips of powerups appearing partially off screen
[*] The spongy mushrooms on the first planet should not disappear forever anymore
[*] Fixed some uneven walls causing problems with the wallclinging in the caves of the first planet
[*] Fixed some special attacks causing problems occasionally
[*] Fixed rare problems with the teleporters on one of the later planets
[*] Fixed several small issues with the background graphics in various places
[*] Fixed jumping on some of the moving platforms on the second planet being bugged 
[*] Loads of small bugfixes and fixes to couple of possible softlocks 
[/list]


[b]For people experiencing issues with the shadow dash powerup[/b]
We are working on a fix to the issue where a small number of players is having problems with performing the shadow dash. This seems to be caused by the Steam controller configurations interfering with the game. You can try to fix the issue by going to the Steam settings and choosing the general controller settings on the controller tab. Make sure the configuration settings box for your controller type is [i]unticked[/i]. You can tick the box for generic controller support. If that doesn't help, try going to the option in the game and switch the buttons for [i]diagonal aim[/i] and [i]special trigger[/i] with each other. We will roll a better fix to the issue as soon as we can.


That would be all for now. We know there is still some issues to fix and improve with the game, but we are working on them. Thank you for the patience. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/7JlrUbf.gif[/img]

notes.title: Another patch released, fixing a load of various issues
notes.content:
Hi there.

New day, new patch. This one doesn't have exact patch notes, but it fixes a big amount of glitches that were happening in the last builds.

Some notable fixes:

[list]

There's a bigger quality of life patch coming soon, stay tuned.

notes.title: Another patch is now here. Fixes some possible soft locks and crashes.
notes.content:
Hi!

MindSeize is now updated with a patch that fixes some issues players have had with the game locking the progression under certain conditions. There's also a couple of experimental fixes, that we are rolling in to see if they help people having those problems.


[list]
[*] The jump button should now always work. There will be more fixes to the controller in the future.
[*] A couple of boss battles that could crash before should not do it anymore
[*] A fix to a console on third planet not activating the things it should in case you saved after using it
[*] Buying a single nanobot now gives you a single nanobot.
[*] Fixed certain flying enemies on third planet causing the camera to go crazy
[*] The player [i]should [/i]be able to meet the Stranger always now
[*] A possible fix to a black screen some players have experienced on the first planet
[/list]

If any of these still keep happening, please let us know.

More fixes will be coming soon. Thank you for your patience, we are very committed to fixing the bugs and issues with MindSeize!

notes.title: First patch is live, fixes several issues big and small. Read the notes.
notes.content:
Hi! 

We are aware of the issues some of you are experiencing with the game and fixing them as fast as we can. 

We just updated MindSeize with the first set of bug fixes, there will be many more to follow. This patch fixes the soft lock moments found on the second planet, as well as the bug that caused the save file to not work in certain rare situations. Downloading the patch should fix the save file, if you still have the problem, send us mail at support@mindseizegame.com and we will fix the file.

Full patch notes are as follows:


[list]
[*] The softlock down the pit on Takomo. There will be a way out now if you happened to save.
[*] A possible softlock up in the factory where the path was blocked even when destroying crates
[*] The junkyard boss won't act strangely anymore (went crazy broken in certain conditions)
[*] Dashkick can now actually dash kick. Balancing this in a later patch.
[*] Enemies destroyed outside of camera now will always die and not turn invincible
[*] Tooltips for the Dash Thrusters and Spider Hold fixed
[*] Double jump works immediately after getting the powerup
[*] You can now jump while crouching
[*] You cannot do the special melee attack anymore while crouching
[*] The sponge mushroomy platforms won't break anymore
[*] Scap magnet now works for scrap from the enemies only, price down a bit
[*] Getting wall jump is now much more difficult if you don't have the dash thrusters
[*] The "return to menu" popup is now on correct layer in every possible scenario
[*] Several small balance fixes and minor bugs
[/list]

[b]
What will come soon in an upcoming patch, but will take a bit more time:[/b]
-Game will remember the weapon you were using in the save that you load
-A fix to the graphic issues of the fast travel map
-popups to explain when you get health or nanobot container powerups
-Way to turn off camera shake and turn on VSYNC. 
-The button prompts will change when you change your controller or keyboard layout, now they only show the default configuration
-A fix to the controller issues some players seem to be experiencing. As a possible quick fix that seems to work in most cases, ensure that you launch the game with only one controller plugged and use that controller for playing.



A lot of things still to work on, but this is a good start. Let us know in the community section in case you find more!

notes.title: MindSeize is now released!
notes.content:
We have worked hard with MindSeize for over 2 years and release for Steam is finally here!
 
Game is playable, but it's still need some polish and misses a few features. Here's the list what we are going to update and add in the game:

[list]
[*] One missing boss fight 
[*] M.C.'s drone's optional skins 
[*] [b]Log book[/b], small lore texts
[*] Boss rush mode 
[*] Easy mode 
[*] Possibility to continue playing after the ending 
[*] Bug and issue fixing
[*] Gameplay balancing
[*] Fixing some visual and sound details 
[*] End credits watchable in game's options  
[*] Steam achievements 
[*] Steam trading cards 
[*] Localization to different languages  
[/list]


Thank you for understanding and please give feedback from our game that we can update it a best as possible! You can report any bugs at the community page and we will take a look and fix them as soon as possible.


Our work is not done yet!

notes.title: Alpha Demo updated
notes.content:
We just updated the Alpha Demo with a couple of bug fixes and some new content.
Included are the following.

[list]
[*]Added Scrap drops to the game. Enemies will now drop resource, that can be used to craft more healing nanobots on save points. This is still in testing phase and will be balanced and fine-tuned based on feedback. Full game will naturally have more uses for Scrap.
[*]Enemies can also drop health or energy
[*]Added a short tutorial section to the beginning of the demo
[*]A couple of additional secrets added
[*]Fixed a lot of bugs (non-16:9 resolutions still cause issues)
[*]Few performance updates
[/list]

This will be the final big update to the demo, as it's difficult to keep working on the demo simultaneously to the full game. We are aware of the multiple small issues still left, we will continue to work on them for the full release.

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension Crew
